parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path. The type-alias-object 'DisplayLinkSequence.AsyncIterator' in that file is almost certainly a local copy introduced to support the sample app's debug HUD without taking a hard dependency on the DebugPanel package. The duplication is therefore structural but intentional — the sample app context makes consolidation inadvisable without a deeper dependency-graph change. No refactor is warranted on this evidence alone.
